method: old vs new ThiefBrain, 100 games/cell, seeds 60000+, vs the two arena trap cops; exact = full information, lag1 = cop cell one move stale (best-case scent proxy)
design: one-ply adversarial wall forecast (placements limited to the cop reach, book p.37) + wall-distance aversion, ACTIVE ONLY on exact information - fed a stale cop cell the forecast dodges phantom walls (measured intermediate: TrapCop lag1 1.00->0.00), so belief play stays conservative distance+openness
